Model specification

Source: R/spec.R
bruce_spec.Rd

Collects priors, optional terms and the fitting strategy. Defaults reproduce the model of the original Rio de Janeiro application, except where noted.

Usage

bruce_spec(
  range_prior = "nn",
  range_prior_prob = 0.5,
  sigma_prior = c(8, 0.01),
  group_rho_prior = c(0.5, 0.75),
  group_rho_fixed = NULL,
  station_effect = TRUE,
  station_prior = c(1, 0.01),
  day_effect = TRUE,
  day_rho_prior = c(0.5, 0.75),
  day_prec_prior = c(3, 0.01),
  day_sd_fixed = NULL,
  biased_prec_prior = c(3, 0.01),
  intercept_prior = c(NA, 0.001),
  covariate_prec = 1/4,
  bias_prec = 1/9,
  int_strategy = "ccd",
  on_collapse = c("retry_then_fix", "fix", "warn", "none"),
  collapse_rho = 0.98,
  collapse_sd_ratio = 10,
  fallback_group_rho = 0.55,
  num_threads = NULL
)

Arguments

range_prior

PC prior on the Matern range: "nn" anchors the median at the median nearest-neighbour distance between stations (the resolution limit of the network), or give a number in metres. The Rio de Janeiro application uses 15000; "nn" is the default here because it adapts to any network without a city-specific constant.

range_prior_prob

Probability that the range is below range_prior.

sigma_prior

PC prior on the field standard deviation, c(u, p) meaning P(sigma > u) = p.

group_rho_prior

PC prior (pc.cor1) on the day-to-day AR(1) correlation of the spatial field.

group_rho_fixed

Fix that correlation at a value instead of estimating it.

station_effect

Include an iid station random effect (absorbs persistent station-level siting bias).

station_prior

PC prior on its standard deviation.

day_effect

Include a city-wide daily AR(1) term.

day_rho_prior, day_prec_prior

Priors of the daily term.

day_sd_fixed

Fix the daily term's standard deviation instead of estimating it.

biased_prec_prior

PC prior on the observation standard deviation of networks with obs_sd = NA.

intercept_prior

c(mean, precision) for the intercept; NA mean uses the mean of reference observations.

covariate_prec, bias_prec

Prior precision of covariate and network offset coefficients (mean 0).

int_strategy

INLA integration strategy.

on_collapse

What to do when the fit degenerates (field day-to-day correlation near 1, or field standard deviation exploding): "retry_then_fix" restarts from a reset mode and, if it collapses again, refits with the correlation fixed at fallback_group_rho; "fix" goes straight to the fixed refit; "warn" only warns; "none" does nothing.

collapse_rho, collapse_sd_ratio

Thresholds of the collapse check: a fit is flagged when the posterior mean correlation exceeds collapse_rho or the field standard deviation exceeds collapse_sd_ratio times the standard deviation of the observations.

fallback_group_rho

Value used when the correlation must be fixed.

num_threads

Passed to INLA (NULL uses INLA's default).

Value

An object of class bruce_spec.
